name: sidebar-12
title: Sidebar 12
description: A sidebar with a calendar: a month to pick a day from, calendars as ticked boxes in folding groups, and your account on top. The picked day becomes the page. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-12. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { calendarGroups, appUser } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data" import { Calendars, DatePicker } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-calendar" import { NavUser } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-user-menu" import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarHeader, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarRail, SidebarSeparator } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" export function AppSidebar({ date, onDateChange, visible, onVisibleChange, ...props }: React.ComponentProps & { date: Date onDateChange: (date: Date) => void visible: string[] onVisibleChange: (next: string[]) => void }) { return ( next && onDateChange(next)} /> New calendar ) }

Installed the "Sidebar 12" block into your components directory under blocks/sidebar-12/.
